meta.name: pr-to-video
meta.description: Turn a GitHub pull request (a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR' in a checked-out repo) into a code-change explainer video — changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor walkthrough built from the diff, commits, and files: the input is a code change, not a website. Not a product promo (/product-launch-video) or a no-PR topic explainer (/faceless-explainer). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把代码改动变成讲解视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常需要向团队讲解代码改动
copy.tagline_en: Turn code changes into an explainer video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to explain code changes to others

howto.what: 把 GitHub 拉取请求(PR)变成代码变更解说视频。它读取 PR 的 diff、提交和文件,规划并渲染成 changelog、新功能、修复或重构的分镜视频,画面采用代码编辑风格。
howto.when: 当你给出 PR 链接、owner/repo#编号,或在已检出仓库中说“这个 PR”,并要求做成视频时触发。若意图不明会先转去 /hyperframes 判断。

say.text: 把 owner/repo#42 的这次改动做成修复解说视频
say.note: 视频会基于该 PR 的 diff 和提交来构建。

say.text: 当前项目里这个 PR 的变更,给我做一个 changelog 视频
say.note: 利用当前已检出的仓库定位“这个 PR”。

howto.what_en: Turns a GitHub pull request into a code-change explainer video: it reads the PR's diff, commits, and files, then plans and renders a frame-by-frame video (changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor) in a fixed code-editorial editor style.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you give a PR URL, an owner/repo#N reference, or say “this PR” in a checked-out repo and ask for a video. If unclear, it routes through /hyperframes first.

say_en.text: Turn https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/123 into a code-change explainer video
say_en.note: Claude reads that PR and starts the video workflow.

say_en.text: Make a fix-explainer video for the changes in owner/repo#42
say_en.note: The video is built from that PR's diff and commits.

say_en.text: Make a changelog video for this PR's changes in the current project
say_en.note: Uses the checked-out repo to locate “this PR”.
